title: Purdue AI Racing team sets track record at Laguna Seca, places second overall in Indy Autonomous Challenge race
summary_en: Purdue AI Racing set a new track record and won first place in the time trials with a 1:27.731 lap, becoming the first autonomous car ever to beat 1:28 at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca in Monterey, California.
